text: Did you know your body can heal itself?
Cut your finger, and within seconds, platelets rush in to plug the leak.
Over the next few days, new skin cells crawl across the gap, until it closes.
Break a bone, and your body builds a bridge across the crack, then turns it back into solid bone.
Many breaks heal in about six to eight weeks.
Your liver can do something even stranger.
Surgeons can remove up to two thirds of a healthy liver, and it grows back.
Skin, bone, liver. Every day, your body is quietly repairing itself.
That little scar? Proof that it works.
